# Extract data for the two country groups
df_education_sub_saharan = df_education[df_education['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
df_education_lmc = df_education[df_education['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

df_gdp_sub_saharan = df_gdp_corrected[df_gdp_corrected['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
df_gdp_lmc = df_gdp_corrected[df_gdp_corrected['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Extract the years as a list
years = [col for col in df_education_sub_saharan.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')]

# Extract the education expenditure and GDP data for each country group
education_sub_saharan = df_education_sub_saharan[years].values[0]
gdp_sub_saharan = df_gdp_sub_saharan[years].values[0]

education_lmc = df_education_lmc[years].values[0]
gdp_lmc = df_gdp_lmc[years].values[0]

# Perform linear regression for each country group
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub_saharan = np.array(education_sub_saharan).reshape(-1, 1)
y_sub_saharan = np.array(gdp_sub_saharan)
model_sub_saharan = LinearRegression()
model_sub_saharan.fit(X_sub_saharan, y_sub_saharan)
coef_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.coef_[0]
p_value_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.score(X_sub_saharan, y_sub_saharan)

# Lower Middle Income Countries
X_lmc = np.array(education_lmc).reshape(-1, 1)
y_lmc = np.array(gdp_lmc)
model_lmc = LinearRegression()
model_lmc.fit(X_lmc, y_lmc)
coef_lmc = model_lmc.coef_[0]
p_value_lmc = model_lmc.score(X_lmc, y_lmc)

coef_sub_saharan, p_value_sub_saharan, coef_lmc, p_value_lmc
